Usually she is summoned because people think that she's a succubus, so she just goes along with it and has sex.

An Eldaz is the creation of an Eldritch and non human but terrestrial humanoid shaped beings. They inherit abilities from both sides of their genealogy, but because of the nature of the Eldritch, whatever the other parent was is unknown after the baby is formed. It becomes its own creature and lineage. It is the first one of its kind.

Each Eldaz is it God in its own right. It has the ability to defy gender. It's gender expression is its own. 

Each Eldaz has its own mind and free will. They are able to mate with other Eldaz that do not share a parent. 

Eldaz often have their own pocket realities.
